title: CAD IR Phase 4 — Assembly graph + joints + URDF compiler
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan extending the CAD IR from single-part to multi-part with parts/joints/connections, Tier 5 assembly validation, and a URDF compiler.
notes: Implementation plan / runbook structure (Tasks 1-12 with code blocks and commit instructions). References an external SPEC for authoritative design. Not a PRD (no user stories/acceptance criteria from user perspective), not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences trade-off), not the SPEC itself (this plans how to implement the spec). Classified as DOC (implementation guide). Some SPEC-like content (type definitions, schemas) is present but in service of executing a plan rather than defining contracts.
